_comment: The simulated KCU1500/C1100 of a Jungfrau DRP for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the lcls2_udp_pcie_apps DevRoot that psdaq/configdb/jungfrau_config.py builds on the card's PCIe map (the card's UDP engines take the modules' packets; the modules themselves are psdaq.sim.simsls). Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
_TxClkFreqRaw: TxClkFreq is 1e-6 x this, in MHz: 185.714 MHz, the 186M timebase's 1300/7 MHz, so check_i2c_clk does not reprogram the Si570
_phyReady: lane 0's 10GbE link to its module is up (jungfrau_config raises 'PGP Link Down for lane' otherwise)
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id as XPM 0 port 0 reports it; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one
